svg.title: The Registration Clock
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-registration-clock; chapter number: 2; title: The Registration Clock; subtitle: How long each step of the SAM and CAGE stack takes, per practitioners; caption: Kizzy Parks pulled a UEI roughly 3 minutes into the entity validation flow. The CAGE code is assigned by DLA at no charge after submission and is never bought (FedOpp, Eric Coffie).; assumptions note: Where a speaker gave only a range, the typical value marks the earliest point given, since no midpoint was testified. Three weeks is shown as 21 days. HUBZone requires the office and 35% of employee home addresses inside a zone (Nick Waters GovCon), against government-wide HUBZone spend of 0.44% (Squared Compass).; note: Sources - Neil McDonnell (QIEmDXcWhSE), SEMSCIO (rRWCLLWqrV0), Kizzy Parks (FWfV2m3K4jY, eIFlVzfusWo), FedOpp (2Bp78kNCVGI).; chart type: horizontal_bars; unit: days; bars: label: CAGE Assignment by DLA; min: 3; max: 21; typical: 3; display: 3 days to 3 weeks (Neil McDonnell); label: CAGE After IRS Verification; min: 7; max: 14; typical: 7; display: About a week or two (SEMSCIO); label: DLA Follow-Up Response Window; min: 3; max: 3; typical: 3; display: 3 business days (Kizzy Parks); label: Registration Login Cadence; min: 7; max: 7; typical: 7; display: At least weekly, since zero reminder emails arrive (Kizzy Parks); label: SAM Renewal Cycle; min: 365; max: 365; typical: 365; display: Every 365 days (FedOpp)

text.title: Assumptions: Where a speaker gave only a range, the typical value marks the earliest point given, since no midpoint was testified. Three weeks is shown as 21 days. HUBZone requires the office and 35% of employee home addresses inside a zone (Nick Waters GovCon), against government-wide HUBZone spend of 0.44% (Squared Compass).
